content: पारमार्थिक {%a.%} (-की|{%f.%}) [परमाथीय हितं ठक्] .²1 Relating to परमार्थ or the highest truth or spiritual knowledge. .²2 Real, essential, truly or really existent; सत्ता त्रिविधा पारमार्थिकी, व्यावहारिकी, प्रातीतिकी च <ls>Vedānta.</ls> .²3 Caring for truth, loving truth or right; न लोकः पारमार्थिकः <ls>Pt. 1. 342</ls>. .²4 Excellent, supremely good, best.
